# CredentialStackSource

Where a run's credential stack came from, most specific first.

**Kind:** a string enum, used in responses.

## Values

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `"Start"` | Named when the run was started. |
| `"Parent"` | Handed down by the run that started this one, which chose it explicitly. |
| `"Definition"` | The default named in the run's definition. |
| `"Namespace"` | The default of the definition's namespace. |
| `"Tenant"` | The tenant's default. |

New values can appear, so treat one you don't know as "something else", not as an error.

## Where it's used

- Inside [`CredentialStackSnapshot`](credential-stack-snapshot.md)
